recommendation: Keep this no-change audit as-is. No additional core source edit is needed for FHIR-36738 unless a future work-group decision asks for broader cross-linking or examples beyond the Published resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-36738 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core clarification for R5 asking that modifier-extension documentation explain how to define a modifier extension and that StructureDefinition documentation explain how root ElementDefinition entries carry type-wide characteristics such as cardinality and definition text.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation in two historical commits titled 'FHIR-36738 Extension / ElementDefinition Clarifications': 753608c2b9de9acd93961c66de18bbdba84cc8ad added the StructureDefinition root-elements section to source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-notes.xml, and 4739b64e17490a52f316d16b3f889525d8b423d5 added the modifier-extension isModifier paragraph to source/extensibility.html.
additional_context: The Jira-linked Zulip thread shows the ambiguity that led to this issue: Gino Canessa could not find documentation that root isModifier declares an extension as a modifier extension, and Lloyd McKenzie explained that the root ElementDefinition also carries type/profile metadata such as cardinality. FHIR-I WGM minutes record FHIR-36738 as Persuasive with a 16-0-2 vote. Later FHIR-37903 is in the same modifier-extension clarification family and has already been audited on the combined branch; it reinforces, rather than contradicts, the current source wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active extensibility page already says root isModifier determines extension versus modifierExtension placement and includes the requested new-modifier-extension clarification. The active StructureDefinition resource notes already include the requested StructureDefinition Root Elements section, including root cardinality and ElementDefinition.definition versus StructureDefinition.description guidance. source/fhir.ini confirms StructureDefinition is an active resource and maps Extension to the active extensibility page.

related_jiras.note: Later Published modifier-extension clarification audited on the combined branch; it confirms the current root isModifier rule and does not require a separate FHIR-36738 edit.
